infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Roots needs access to your contacts so you can import only the people you choose.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Roots uses notifications for privacy-safe follow-up, birthday, and important moment reminders.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Roots uses your camera so you can attach a photo to a conversation or add a photo for someone in your Roots.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Roots accesses your photo library so you can attach a photo to a conversation or add a photo for someone in your Roots.

plugins.contactsPermission: Roots needs access to your contacts so you can import the people you want to stay close to.

plugins.photosPermission: Roots uses your photo library so you can attach photos to chats and profile pictures.
plugins.cameraPermission: Roots uses your camera so you can snap a photo to attach to a chat or profile picture.
